Limits on IPC input

Source: R/read.R
arrow_limits.Rd

arrow_limits() bounds what arrow_read() accepts from untrusted input. Each limit is checked before the bytes it covers are used, and going over one is a zuarrow_limit_error.

Usage

arrow_limits(
  max_message = 2^31 - 1,
  max_depth = 64L,
  max_batch_rows = 2^31 - 1,
  max_bytes = Inf
)

Arguments

max_message

The most bytes one message header or body may hold, and the most bytes one compressed buffer may claim when decompressed.

max_depth

The deepest nesting a schema may have.

max_batch_rows

The most rows one record batch may hold.

max_bytes

The most bytes of input in all.

Value

A list of class zuarrow_limits.

Examples

arrow_limits(max_bytes = 2^30)
#> $max_message
#> [1] 2147483647
#> 
#> $max_depth
#> [1] 64
#> 
#> $max_batch_rows
#> [1] 2147483647
#> 
#> $max_bytes
#> [1] 1073741824
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "zuarrow_limits"
